mapper.insert: INSERT INTO onboardings ( user_id, destination_id, destination_type, transport_mode, max_travel_time, budget_deposit, budget_rent, min_safety_score ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{destinationId}, #{destinationType}, #{transportMode}, #{maxTravelTime}, #{budgetDeposit}, #{budgetRent}, #{minSafetyScore} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE destination_id = VALUES(destination_id), destination_type = VALUES(destination_type), transport_mode = VALUES(transport_mode), max_travel_time = VALUES(max_travel_time), budget_deposit = VALUES(budget_deposit), budget_rent = VALUES(budget_rent), min_safety_score = VALUES(min_safety_score)
